headline: From plateau to a plan you can actually execute.
subheading: The work starts with your customer, not a template. Everything we build together comes from a genuine understanding of who you're trying to reach and what they need to hear from you.

steps.title: Free strategy call
steps.description: We talk about your business, where growth has stalled, and what you think is on the other side of it. This isn't a pitch. It's a real conversation to understand where you are and whether working together makes sense. If we're a good fit, great. If not, I'll tell you honestly.

steps.title: Customer & market discovery
steps.description: This is the most important part of the engagement. I dig into your market, your competitors, and your customers through real research: who your best customers are, what brought them to you, what signals exist in your early wins with new types of buyers, and what it would take to reach more of them. This is where the real insight comes from, and it's what makes everything that follows actually work.

steps.title: Strategy delivery
steps.description: You get a clear, actionable strategy built around your next customer. Not a 50-page document you'll never open again, but a focused plan that defines who you're targeting, what they need to hear, and how to reach them. We walk through it together so there are no unanswered questions.

steps.title: Execution & iteration
steps.description: A strategy is only valuable if it gets used. I stay involved to help you implement, review what's working, and adjust as you learn more about your new customer base. Whether that's ongoing support or getting the first phase off the ground, I don't disappear after delivery.

cta.headline: The first step is always a conversation.
cta.subheading: Book a free call and let's talk about what growth looks like for your business.
